hero.title: Geographic coverage
hero.lead: Districts are coloured where a record in the archive documents a bonded-labour system there. Select a coloured district to see its figures and the records behind them.

map.label: Map of Nepal showing district-level bonded labour evidence
map.noValue: No comparable district-level value is recorded for this indicator.

howToRead.label: How to read this map:
howToRead.text: Colour shows that at least one record in the archive documents the system in that district. It does not measure prevalence, and a district without colour may simply have no record here yet. Each figure in the district panel names the record it comes from and keeps that source’s scope and date.
howToRead.boundaries: Boundaries: the district outline file used here has no shapes for Dailekh or Rupandehi, so those two districts appear as gaps.
